summary: Inventory variables set per-host values (like ansible_host, http_port) or group-wide values under vars (like ansible_user), so you don't pass them on the command line.
questions: How do I set variables for a host in an Ansible inventory?
How do I set ansible_user for a whole group?
Where do I put group variables in a YAML inventory?

answer_card.title: Host and group variables
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
webservers:
  hosts:
    webserver01:
      ansible_host: 192.0.2.140
      http_port: 80
  vars:
    ansible_user: my_server_user
```
Host keys apply to one host; `vars` applies to every host in the group.
